info.confession: Main Church 15min before Weekend Mass when priests are available.
devotions: Rosary on Zoom: Monday-Wednesday 9.30pm; 4th Friday of the month 12:30pm at Temporary Chapel.
Divine Mercy: Thursday 12.15pm at Annex Building Level 3 (except public holidays).
Breaking of the Word: Thursday 8pm-9.30pm; Wednesday 11am at Annex, Level 2 Room 4.
Intercessory Prayers: Wednesday 11:45am at Annex, Level 2 Room 4.
good_to_know: Main Church: closed Monday-Friday; open Saturday at 4pm and full day Sundays.
Temporary Chapel: JM Beurel Centre (Annex Building) Level 1, Monday-Friday 10am-7pm.
